about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport P270e ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport P270e is the plug-in hybrid variant of Land Rover's compact SUV, pairing a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor. It sits alongside the P300e in the Discovery Sport PHEV range and is understood to have been introduced as a later badge variant — though the exact introduction year is not confirmed. The P270e shares the same 1.5-litre I3 petrol architecture as the P300e, with the badge denoting a different power output tune rather than a distinct engine family.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace 1.5L I3 petrol + electric engines for every Discovery Sport P270e on the road.

compatibility.intro: The Discovery Sport P270e is a plug-in hybrid, which means its powertrain combines a 1.5-litre three-cylinder petrol engine with an electric motor and battery pack. The petrol engine is derived from the Ingenium family and is shared with the P300e, though the P270e badge represents a different output tune. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
